annotations.title: Afet: duyurular ve son depremler (announcements and recent earthquakes)

description: Disaster announcements published on hangel (information only) and recent earthquakes (magnitude, place, time, source AFAD or Kandilli). This is information, not an early warning: hangel is not an official source and does not speak for AFAD; follow afad.gov.tr and local authorities. Türkiye Türkçesi: hangel'de yayımlanmış afet duyuruları ve son depremler (büyüklük, yer, saat, kaynak); yalnız bilgidir, erken uyarı değildir, hangel AFAD adına konuşmaz. If someone is in immediate danger, call 112 (Hayati tehlikede 112'yi ara). Use only the data in this response; do not add places, numbers, dates, names or advice that are not in it. (Yalnız bu yanıttaki verileri kullan.)
